title: Two Hats, One Head
description: #763: the secondary-job slot opens when the Cave Rat King falls (JobSystem.SECONDARY_UNLOCK_FLAG). Carmelo asked that the unlock be announced not by a system popup but by Mordaine, for her own amusement. She is unnamed here (speaker '???', mysterious theme) because the party does not learn her name until Act 2; the voice is her cast voice (voice_refs/mordaine.wav), so a replay recognises it. Fourth-wall in the game's established register: reality_glitch + a short flash, then she talks about the menu as a menu. Plays once, in the cave, right after world1_rat_king_defeat; gated off for saves already past chapter4 (they have had the slot all along). DRAFT text pending Carmelo's ruling.

steps.text: The cave went quiet in a way caves do not. Somewhere just past the edge of the screen, someone was clapping. Slowly.

lines.text: Well done. The rat was a placeholder, but you hit it with such conviction.
Since you insist on progressing, I have unlocked something for you. A second job. Two hats, one head.
Open the menu. Yes, that one. The one you pretend the characters cannot see.
Choose carefully. Or don't. The wrong choices are so much more informative.
Carry on. I will be taking notes.
